title: iberis pruitii var. granatensis
intro: Iberis pruitii var. granatensis, commonly known as Rockrose, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The plant has been found to have health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help in reducing stress and improving overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Rockrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions like antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
